prewrittenContent.body:

prewrittenContent.body:
Slide 1: The 3-second test: does your website pass?
Slide 2: A homeowner lands on your site. They give it 3 seconds before hitting back.
Slide 3: In those 3 seconds: they need to see what you do, where you work, and how to call.
Slide 4: Most contractor websites fail this test — blurry photos, no phone number, no services listed.
Slide 5: Failing the 3-second test costs you 5-10 calls per month.
